data_scope: 本题无附件数据。全部输入为 (a) 题面结构信息（Figure 1 拓扑）与 (b) 文献/标准参数或显式假设。无外部数据文件导入。

parameters.name: responder walk speed (clear air, no load)
parameters.source: SFPE/evacuation literature typical range 1.1-1.4 m/s; take 1.2 as central assumption

parameters.name: firefighter loaded walk speed
parameters.source: assumption: SCBA gear slows to ~80% of P1

parameters.name: small office room visual check time
parameters.source: assumption: unobstructed single-room visual sweep; room area 15-20 m^2

parameters.name: smoke visibility->speed factor
parameters.source: assumption from smoke-density/visibility-walk-speed qualitative literature; simplified linear floor 0.3

parameters.name: communication delay (per room mark/report)
parameters.source: assumption; failure modeled as Bernoulli(p_fail) doubling report time

parameters.name: room occupancy (Q3 scenarios)
parameters.source: scenario definitions; affects check time multiplier 1.5x if occupied (assist/verify occupants moving)

geometry_assumptions.note: Figure 1 无尺寸标注，以下几何为显式假设并在论文中声明；相对比例忠于题图。

basic_scenario.exit_positions: both ends of hallway, opposite sides

scenario_B.name: 2-floor daycare + office (priority occupants)
scenario_B.floor_1: daycare: 4 rooms + lobby, high priority, occupants=children/staff

scenario_C.name: 3-floor mixed-use: warehouse + labs + offices (non-standard L-shaped top floor)
scenario_C.floor_1: warehouse: 2 large open areas + loading bay
scenario_C.floor_2: labs: 5 rooms, chemical hazard (priority, slow check)

cleaning_rules: 所有数值参数集中定义在代码参数区，禁止散落的魔法数字
每次运行把参数快照写入 results/runs/<run>/params.json
建筑几何与参数修改必须同时更新本文件
leakage_checks: 不适用监督学习训练/测试划分；模拟器校验用枚举精确解交叉验证（Q2 fallback）
蒙特卡洛报告均值+-95% CI，禁止用单次实现代表分布结论
acceptance_criteria: 参数表 P1-P8 每项有 value/units/source/confidence
几何假设覆盖 basic + 2 个应用场景
无未声明来源的魔法数字
